customManagers.description: Bump Helm chart_version values passed into Terraform modules (helm_release lives inside the module, not in the root main.tf, so the native terraform manager can't see it). Annotate the line above chart_version with a renovate comment.
Bump Authentik postgres_image_tag passed into the postgresql Terraform module (image tag lives in the module input, not a native terraform resource, so the native terraform manager can't see it).

packageRules.description: This repo is the GitOps source itself, referenced as an Argo CD git source with targetRevision: HEAD. It is not a version to bump.
Refresh .terraform.lock.hcl on a schedule. Explicitly scoped to matchManagers so this can never touch anything but the terraform lock file, even if other managers get lock-file support added later.
helm + kubernetes providers and the terraform required_version constraint repeat almost identically across every phase, group them into one PR instead of many near-duplicates.

Postgres images, both StatefulSets and the Authentik Terraform postgresql module: allow minor/patch bumps only, never major, since major postgres upgrades need manual migration steps (pg_upgrade, dump/restore, etc).

Auto-merge patch-level updates for Argo CD targetRevisions and Kubernetes manifest images. Terraform is intentionally excluded, both the native manager and the custom.regex Helm chart_version / postgres_image_tag trackers, so anything terraform-related always waits for manual review.
